title: Bounded Git adapter
responsibility: Runs Git commands in the configured repository with bounded execution, Git-specific authentication variables, and text, byte, or status-returning interfaces.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository working directory used as the cwd for every Git invocation.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.run.args
inputs.description: Git argument vector, passed without shell interpolation.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.run.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, child environment overrides, deadline and output limit.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.bytes.args
inputs.description: Git argument vector, passed without shell interpolation.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.bytes.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, child environment overrides, deadline and output limit.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.attempt.args
inputs.description: Git argument vector for a non-throwing nonzero-exit probe.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.attempt.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, child environment overrides, deadline and output limit.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.exec.args
inputs.description: Git argument vector, passed directly to the Git executable.

inputs.name: GitAdapter.exec.options
inputs.description: Optional stdin, environment overrides, deadline and output limit; cwd remains the configured repository root.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.run
outputs.description: Standard output decoded as UTF-8 and trimmed; nonzero exits reject with Git stderr in the error.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.bytes
outputs.description: Unmodified stdout bytes; nonzero exits reject with Git stderr in the error.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.attempt
outputs.description: Trimmed stdout on exit code zero, or undefined on a nonzero exit.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.exec
outputs.description: Exit code, stdout bytes and stderr text from the bounded Git process.

outputs.name: GitAdapter.isRepository
outputs.description: True only when Git reports that the configured root is inside a work tree.

errors.name: Git command failure
errors.description: run and bytes reject when Git exits nonzero, including its stderr in the message

errors.name: Bounded command failure
errors.description: Git execution can fail to launch, time out, be aborted, or exceed the configured output limit
